5e835646-81d2-56de-9e83-4157b65b15c9.content: During a week when the user watered every day based only on the soil surface, the leaves of one plant turned yellow.

546401c1-d704-5272-a1d1-8436d3047c08.content: The next day, the user moved the pot inward from the windowsill so the same wind would not knock it over.

597aad34-4183-5fc7-8179-9f213589da94.content: The user's maternal aunt considers understanding the sunlight at a pot's location more important than watering frequency when caring for it.

0cdbc053-b3b1-59d9-86fc-265684f83cc7.content: Before creating a plant-care reminder, check each plant's name and most recent watering date.
